請將下列英文翻譯成中文：（5 分）In The Impact of 911, the author's insistence on the police following orderswithout questioning them, a characteristic of a centralized, paramilitary mindset,has created heated controversies on the Internet. According to the majority'sopinion, what needs to be taken into urgent consideration for the police in ademocratic society is that they must cultivate fairness and thoughtfulness.
請將下列中文翻譯成英文：（10 分）私人空間和公共領域之間經常有條涇渭分明的界線，可用來約束警察干預某些社會事件的職權。然而，公私疆界之間的模糊程度卻可依狀況不同而有所變通。

英文短篇寫作（35 分）：請閱讀以下短文，並依指示寫作。文長必須在三百字以內。Read the following passage, and write an English essay of no more than300 words. Your essay has to comprise two parts: (1) the author's argument;(2) your response to the author's argument.The future application of virtual reality to the field of law enforcementtraining will have far-reaching implications. Simulated line-of-dutyevents could be designed to impress upon students the importance of thegoals of officer survival training. A creative employment of gaming as apossible training tool should not be underestimated as “pop” science.Gaming is an engaging and interactive method of training others and willhave wide application in the coming years as it becomes embraced bymany professions, including law enforcement.
